title: Contingency role training and coordinated exercises need dated records
remediation: The deployment continuity exercise lead identifies the required trainees and role-specific training schedule, reviews training when roles or systems change, and coordinates a test with the owners of related plans. Record the dated training and exercise results, approved scenarios, corrective actions and retests. Use the hub restore drill as a component input when the hub is in scope.

milestones.title: Collect training completion, coordinated exercise records and closure evidence for corrective actions
